decisive_spans.text: Fungal skin culture: black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species

response.rationale: The presence of black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species on fungal skin culture and pigmented hyphae are direct and specific evidence for Phaeohyphomycosis. While other diagnoses mention some consistent findings, none have such direct and specific laboratory confirmation.
